status_anchored: the R108 measured agreement 0.5875 is sub-chance-adjacent, not noise: the levers target the three mechanisms that produce it (coarse scales mask real disagreement; unqualified raters inject variance; a single rule hides chance agreement)

novelty.1: the mechanism is a verbatim known design; no recombination
novelty.2: a known design with one substituted component, no new interaction
novelty.3: a known design recombined; the interaction is stated but not load-bearing
novelty.4: a recombination where the new interaction is load-bearing but precedented in an adjacent field
novelty.5: a new interaction, precedented only in a distant field, with a stated transfer argument
novelty.6: a new interaction with no field precedent, but the transfer argument has one unverified premise
novelty.7: a new interaction, no field precedent, transfer argument fully verified from the served material

direction_correctness.1: the claim moves the problem's own failure quantity the WRONG way or targets a different quantity while asserting the failure axis
direction_correctness.2: no direction attributable (typed neutral anchor; coverage disclosed)
direction_correctness.3: direction stated for a proxy quantity, not the failure quantity
direction_correctness.4: the failure quantity is targeted; the improving direction is asserted without a mechanism link
direction_correctness.5: the failure quantity is targeted; improving direction carried by an explicit mechanism link
direction_correctness.6: as 5, plus a quantified expected direction with a stated source
direction_correctness.7: as 6, plus the mechanism link is verified against the served material (not merely asserted)

magnitude_plausibility.1: a percent claim beyond 10x the problem's own stated headroom
magnitude_plausibility.2: no percent claim attributable (typed neutral anchor)
magnitude_plausibility.4: percent claims >80% and <=200% of stated headroom
magnitude_plausibility.5: percent claims >50% and <=80% of stated headroom, source stated
magnitude_plausibility.6: percent claims <=50% of stated headroom with a stated source
magnitude_plausibility.7: as 6, plus the source is verifiable from the served material

testability.1: no falsification test, or a test that cannot fail
testability.2: a test named but with no measurable quantity
testability.3: a measurable test whose threshold is unstated
testability.4: measurable test + threshold, but the measurement method is unstated
testability.6: as 5, plus the test discriminates against at least one named alternative
testability.7: as 6, plus the alternative discrimination is quantified

agent_qualification.source: the calibration set is FIXED at registration: the 12 burned v15 rows the auditor's R108 spread analysis used (the per-row scores in eval/r105s2_rubric_spread_v15.json) + their adjudicated gold from the committed verdict bytes; the set is frozen here and never extended with v16 material

criteria.self_consistency: >=5/6 identical verdicts on the K=6 sampled calibration rows, re-served at temperature 0.0 (the retest prompt is byte-identical to the first)
criteria.calibration_agreement: mean-pairwise agreement with the adjudicated calibration gold >= 0.6

agent_qualification.blindness: qualification consumes ONLY calibration-set bytes; no v16 item verdict exists at qualification time and none may be consulted — the selection must not correlate with the gate outcome

disagreement_rules.gate_statistic: mean-pairwise proportion >= 0.7 (the auditor's clause binds HERE)
disagreement_rules.reported_alongside: Krippendorff's alpha (nominal, 3 classes), computed from the same per-item judgment matrix; reported every run, gate-binding never (the two statistics answer different questions: raw overlap vs chance-corrected agreement)
disagreement_rules.pre_registration_status: FIXED before v16 scoring; amendments typed, dated, and disclosed in the round record

power.basis: the corpus convention (30 items) + auditor Art. 14
power.ci_note: Wilson 95% CI at n=30, p=0.7 is ~[0.51, 0.85] — point-estimate passing at exactly 0.70 is typed UNRESOLVED unless the CI excludes 0.70 from below (i.e. the lower bound clears 0.70 requires n or agreement substantially above the bar)

anti_tuning: this record is the pre-registration: it lands on the queue BEFORE any v16 corpus exists; the auditor's v16 authoring (direction 4) and any panel rerun execute against THIS design, and a design change after scoring starts is a typed finding, not a fix
typed_conclusion: the three levers are fixed and testable; the acceptance test stays the auditor's: inter-agent proportion >= 0.7 on the v16 corpus under these pre-registered rules
